title: User stricter conditions for the demo board
purpose: A user pack may only tighten the manufacturing floor and platform requirements. It never loosens them; a looser user value is recorded as clamped.
assumptions: Values are user preferences for this demo, not manufacturer capabilities.
The soft clearance preference is intentionally looser than the hard floor to prove it cannot loosen it.

sources.title: User-provided stricter profile
sources.note: demo input, not a datasheet claim

rules.intent: User demands 0.30 mm everywhere, above the 0.25 mm platform value.
User prefers a larger via drill than the manufacturing floor.
Soft preference only; 0.10 mm is below the hard floor and must not reduce it.
